issue.title: Launch approval and macro-group tests reject the new submission timestamp transport
issue.description: At f6ff20ef2a, tests/test_launch_approval.py and tests/test_launch_approval_tui.py fake_launch signatures do not accept extra_env now passed by launch_request_response.py; tests/test_multi_prompt_launcher_macro_groups.py expects exact environment dictionaries without SASE_LAUNCH_SUBMITTED_AT. Master Gate 38983979564 fails five nodes across these files. Isolated launch approval and segment-extra-env nodes reproduce. Preserve the actual-submission contract: accept and assert the stored timestamp in test fakes; pin submission time in macro-group tests and assert it is shared without discarding existing SLOT/force-reuse assertions. This is not old sase-ot (segment_extra_env=None call shape); it was introduced by fae5cf5076. No active causal epic: sase-1li is closed. Release integration repair may close this task once all five nodes pass.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic new extra_env keyword rejected by explicit fake signatures and additional timestamp key rejected by exact dictionary assertions; reproduced in CI and isolated local pytest.

issue.creation_reason: The sase-1lh.7 lander reproduced release-blocking Master Gate failures introduced by the already-closed sase-1li landing commit fae5cf5076.
